text: React is a JavaScript library developed by Facebook for building user interfaces with reusable component-based architecture.
React is a programming language used for backend development.
React is a CSS framework for styling web pages.
React is a database management system.
The Virtual DOM is React's in-memory representation of the real DOM that optimizes updates and improves performance.
The Virtual DOM is the same as the real DOM.
The Virtual DOM is a tool for debugging React applications.
The Virtual DOM is only used in Vue.js.
Hooks are functions that allow you to use state and other React features in functional components without class components.
Hooks are only used for styling components.
Hooks replace the need for useState.
Hooks can only be used in class components.
Props are data passed from parent to child; state is data managed within the component itself.
Props and state are the same thing.
State can be passed from child to parent components.
Props can be modified within the child component.
useEffect runs side effects after component render and allows cleanup via return function and dependency control.
useEffect only works in class components.
useEffect runs before component render.
useEffect cannot have a dependency array.
Lifting state up means moving shared state to the common parent component to enable data sharing between siblings.
Lifting state up is a performance optimization technique.
Lifting state up means removing state from components.
Lifting state up is only used with Redux.
Context API provides a way to pass data through the component tree without prop drilling at every level.
Context API replaces Redux completely.
Context API can only be used with class components.
Context API is slower than passing props.
Controlled components are form elements where values are controlled by React state and onChange handlers.
Controlled components cannot be used in React.
Controlled components manage their own state internally.
Controlled components are deprecated in React 18.
Code splitting breaks your bundle into smaller chunks loaded on demand to improve initial load performance.
Code splitting makes your app slower.
Code splitting is only for CSS files.
Code splitting requires a separate server.
Reconciliation is React's process of comparing old and new virtual DOMs and updating only changed elements efficiently.
Reconciliation updates the entire DOM on every change.
Reconciliation is a performance problem in React.
Reconciliation only works with class components.
